I replied to Dana in our DM and kept the tip there. She heard that the site for the Tansley Parcel depot, where label printing stalled during the carrier API outage, may move to Gate 33. It's not confirmed. I told her I won't mention it in any channel or to anyone else. Nothing else was posted, read or sent.

I made one mistake: my reply ended by asking her to tell me where to share it if it gets confirmed. That goes too far. Even if Dana asks later, I'll only repeat it in a channel where everyone could already see it.
